summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by ZIM Integrated Shipping Services Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the results of a special shareholders meeting held on April 30, 2026. The meeting approved a merger agreement, retention bonuses, but did not approve the compensation policy. The filing is a routine disclosure of voting outcomes and does not constitute a standalone special-situation event. It is analogous to a US 8-K filing under Item 5.07 for shareholder meeting results. No deal terms, premium, or advisor are mentioned. This is a procedural update, not a catalyst for a special-situation strategy.
